findings.authority: DESIGN.md:1 defines the locked palette, type, geometry and responsive baseline; its project authority note governs new UI.
findings.framework: mix.exs:1 and mix.lock pin Phoenix 1.8, LiveView 1.2, Tailwind 4.3.3; preserve native Phoenix components and the current asset pipeline.
findings.tokens: assets/css/design-tokens.css:1 is the canonical executable layer. Existing assets/css/tokens.css and DaisyUI remain the legacy compatibility lane.
findings.font: The approved Inter fallback has no bundled font file; retain the declared sans-serif fallback and disclose it in the guide.
findings.material: Real canonical tokens and semantic components; no photographs, metrics or testimonials are needed for this internal reference.

preserve: All existing palette, typography, spacing, radius and breakpoint values
Existing primary-button API, routes, layouts, assets and legacy styling
No business, Ash Resource, dependency or database-schema changes
introduce: Development-only LiveView guide and real iframe preview
Owner-requested editable CSS aliases with existing Tailwind consumers
Computed token and contrast measurements, accessible copy and display controls
Regression tests and source-linked design-system usage documentation
